gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-recia: Cherry Swash looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals. And Recia, a serif, answers with a measured thick-thin ratio you notice only up close.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-alegreya: Alegreya reads like a bookish page, its contrast lightly flexed like spring wire and its apertures too wide to fill in. And Cherry Swash above it draws with the steady line of a technical pen, so the heading stays blunt while the text stays comfortable.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-alegreya-sc: Authoritative is the mood Alegreya SC brings, a serif whose wide s never tightens and whose curves carry a subtle weight gradient. But Cherry Swash holds every stroke to a constant width, commanding where the body is moderate and calm.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-alike-angular: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and draws everything as if with one nib, diagonals as heavy as verticals. Alike Angular, a serif, adds slight thick-thin variation; give it a modest size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-alyamama: Alyamama is a serif with curve endings kept well apart and a soft thick-thin difference across each word, refined and traditional. Cherry Swash has no brush-style swell anywhere, so the body's gentle rhythm carries a long stretch easily.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ancizar-serif: Ancizar Serif reads bookish and editorial, with the modest contrast of lightly engraved brass and a visibly gaping c. Meanwhile Cherry Swash is drawn as if with a marker tip, so let Ancizar Serif run at a generous size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-andada-pro: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe, with strokes that never vary. Cherry Swash is best at commanding attention through that constant line, while Andada Pro, a serif, is best at letting the eye drift through counters and arch shoulders that thin slowly into lighter joins.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-aref-ruqaa: Dignified is the feel of Aref Ruqaa, a serif with open bowls. Cherry Swash bends thin plastic-tubing strokes into a distinctive heading, and the body below adds friendly, mild contrast with diagonals slightly lighter than its verticals.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Cherry Swash has no thick-thin swell like a pointed brush, just a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as the verticals. Aref Ruqaa Ink, a text serif, adds hairlines that are present but never razor thin.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-average: Average has gaping mouths on the e and curves thickened slightly like a reed pen, literary and authoritative. Average tapers mildly where strokes turn, while Cherry Swash holds one constant line width; if the heading goes small, that commanding presence fades.
